baseline.description: Original exact Git blob loaded into an isolated offline fixture after implementation; 4201 chunks produced corpus_capacity. This is a reproduced source baseline, not historical production evidence.

memory_measurements.cold_initial_boundary: Before final candidate-dedup refinement; tracemalloc includes cold legacy backfill. Motivated explicit operational backfill rather than a first-request latency promise.
memory_measurements.boundary: Offline SQLite fixture with source fingerprints in receipts. Python heap and total process RSS are distinct; no production concurrency, throughput, general relevance or SLA claim.
memory_measurements.retained_diagnostics: Initial Windows RSS collection failed before retrieval because a ctypes handle had no explicit signature. Corrected without changing fixture; original cold and intermediate warm receipts remain separate.

deployment_requirements: Run migrations through 0017_product_governance, then explicit lexical backfill before allowing Java research admission on a large existing database.

RAG_MAX_CORPUS_CHUNKS now bounds the small-corpus in-memory path; it is not a global 4000-chunk rejection threshold.
Verify PostgreSQL query plans, actual authorization roles and real retrieval through Java in isolated component acceptance.
remaining_boundaries: Database posting lists still grow with corpus size; source quota and SQL resource monitoring remain necessary.
